display.purpose: Rare, high-impact public-page statements and the About hero.

headline.purpose: Landing thesis, dashboard greeting, project identity, and primary route statements.

body.purpose: Instructions, explanations, and supporting operational context.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, metric keys, table headings, boundaries, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: anchoring
shadows.purpose: Quiet anchoring for resting cards and panels.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Floating or raised layers that must separate from dense workspaces.

shadows.name: artifact
shadows.purpose: The landing architecture frame and major modal artifacts only.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for direct control-state changes.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Button, field, border, color, and compact hover transitions.

motion.name: loading-shimmer
motion.purpose: Neutral skeleton loading only; route-entry animation remains disabled.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Near-instant fallback for all animation and transition durations when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action within a local control group.
components.css: .ds-doc-btn-primary { align-items:center; background:var(--dg-primary, #F97316); border:1px solid var(--dg-primary, #F97316); border-radius:var(--dg-radius-sm, 8px); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); color:var(--dg-on-primary, #160A02); cursor:pointer; display:inline-flex; font-family:var(--dg-font, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:.875rem; font-weight:560; justify-content:center; min-height:38px; padding:8px 14px; transition:background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-doc-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--dg-primary-hover, #FB8A3C); border-color:var(--dg-primary-hover, #FB8A3C); box-shadow:0 6px 16px -10px rgba(249,115,22,.7); } .ds-doc-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F97316; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-doc-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet alternative or supporting action beside a primary control.
components.css: .ds-doc-btn-secondary { align-items:center; background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--dg-line-strong, rgba(255,255,255,.14)); border-radius:var(--dg-radius-sm, 8px); color:var(--dg-ink-2, #B6BDC9); cursor:pointer; display:inline-flex; font-family:var(--dg-font, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:.875rem; font-weight:560; justify-content:center; min-height:38px; padding:8px 14px; transition:background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-doc-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--dg-surface-2, #1A1E27); color:var(--dg-ink, #EDEFF3); } .ds-doc-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F97316; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-doc-btn-secondary:active { background:var(--dg-surface-3, #202530); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact recessed field for configuration and evidence filters.
components.css: .ds-doc-field { color:var(--dg-ink-2, #B6BDC9); display:grid; font-family:var(--dg-font, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:.82rem; font-weight:560; gap:6px; } .ds-doc-field input { background:var(--au-field, #0F1117); border:1px solid var(--dg-line-strong, rgba(255,255,255,.14)); border-radius:var(--dg-radius-sm, 8px); box-shadow:none; color:var(--dg-ink, #EDEFF3); font:inherit; font-family:var(--dg-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); font-size:.84rem; min-height:38px; padding:8px 12px; transition:border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); width:280px; } .ds-doc-field input:hover { border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22); } .ds-doc-field input:focus { border-color:#F97316; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(249,115,22,.18); outline:0; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The selected control-plane destination in the authenticated shell.
components.html: Infrastructure
components.css: .ds-doc-nav { background:var(--au-1, #0F1117); border:1px solid var(--dg-line, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); border-radius:var(--dg-radius, 12px); font-family:var(--dg-font, Geist, sans-serif); padding:8px; width:220px; } .ds-doc-nav-item { align-items:center; background:rgba(249,115,22,.12); border:1px solid rgba(249,115,22,.28); border-radius:8px; color:var(--dg-ink, #EDEFF3); display:flex; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:560; gap:10px; min-height:40px; padding:8px 10px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-doc-nav-mark { background:#F97316; border-radius:2px; height:16px; width:3px; } .ds-doc-nav-item:hover { background:rgba(249,115,22,.16); } .ds-doc-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F97316; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Semantic Status Chips
components.description: Compact verified-state labels; semantic hues never act as page decoration.
components.css: .ds-doc-status-set { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; } .ds-doc-chip { align-items:center; border:1px solid; border-radius:999px; display:inline-flex; font-family:var(--dg-font, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:.72rem; font-weight:560; gap:6px; line-height:1; padding:4px 9px 4px 8px; } .ds-doc-chip i { background:currentColor; border-radius:50%; height:6px; width:6px; } .ds-doc-chip-success { background:rgba(34,197,94,.12); border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.28); color:#4ADE80; } .ds-doc-chip-warning { background:rgba(234,179,8,.12); border-color:rgba(234,179,8,.28); color:#FACC15; } .ds-doc-chip-danger { background:rgba(239,68,68,.12); border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.28); color:#F87171; } .ds-doc-chip-info { background:rgba(59,130,246,.12); border-color:rgba(59,130,246,.28); color:#93C5FD; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: A flat content surface where state and evidence carry the hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-doc-card { background:var(--dg-surface, #12151C); border:1px solid var(--dg-line, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); border-radius:var(--dg-radius, 12px); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.24); color:var(--dg-ink, #EDEFF3); font-family:var(--dg-font, Geist, sans-serif); padding:20px; width:320px; } .ds-doc-eyebrow { color:var(--dg-primary-ink, #FB923C); font-family:var(--dg-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); font-size:.68rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.06em; margin:0 0 8px; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-doc-card h3 { font-size:1.05rem; letter-spacing:-.025em; margin:0 0 16px; } .ds-doc-card dl { display:grid; gap:8px; margin:0; } .ds-doc-card dl div { border-top:1px solid var(--dg-line, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); display:grid; gap:12px; grid-template-columns:80px 1fr; padding-top:8px; } .ds-doc-card dt { color:var(--dg-muted, #9AA3B2); font-family:var(--dg-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); font-size:.68rem; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-doc-card dd { color:var(--dg-ink-2, #B6BDC9); font-family:var(--dg-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); font-size:.8rem; margin:0; }

components.name: Evidence Table
components.description: A dense, scan-friendly record of deployment fields and their authoritative values.
components.css: .ds-doc-table-wrap { background:var(--dg-surface, #12151C); border:1px solid var(--dg-line, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); border-radius:var(--dg-radius, 12px); overflow:hidden; } .ds-doc-table { border-collapse:collapse; color:var(--dg-ink, #EDEFF3); font-family:var(--dg-font, Geist, sans-serif); min-width:520px; width:100%; } .ds-doc-table th { background:var(--au-1, #0F1117); color:var(--dg-muted, #9AA3B2); font-family:var(--dg-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); font-size:.66rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.06em; padding:10px 14px; text-align:left; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-doc-table td { border-top:1px solid var(--dg-line, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); color:var(--dg-ink-2, #B6BDC9); font-size:.88rem; padding:11px 14px; } .ds-doc-table td:nth-child(2) { color:var(--dg-ink, #EDEFF3); font-family:var(--dg-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); font-size:.8rem; } .ds-doc-table tbody tr:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.025); } .ds-doc-table :focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F97316; outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Control Path Artifact
components.description: The evidence-first architecture pattern used to explain ownership and runtime progression.
components.css: .ds-doc-architecture { background:var(--au-1, #0F1117); border:1px solid var(--dg-line-strong, rgba(255,255,255,.14)); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 28px 60px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.88); color:var(--dg-ink, #EDEFF3); font-family:var(--dg-font, Geist, sans-serif); margin:0; padding:16px; } .ds-doc-architecture figcaption { color:var(--dg-primary-ink, #FB923C); font-family:var(--dg-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); font-size:.68rem; letter-spacing:.08em; margin-bottom:14px; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-doc-architecture ol { display:grid; gap:8px; grid-template-columns:repeat(4, minmax(100px, 1fr)); list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; } .ds-doc-architecture li { background:var(--dg-surface, #12151C); border:1px solid var(--dg-line, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); border-radius:12px; display:grid; gap:4px; min-height:92px; padding:12px; position:relative; } .ds-doc-architecture li:not(:last-child)::after { background:#F97316; content:""; height:1px; position:absolute; right:-9px; top:50%; width:9px; } .ds-doc-architecture span { color:var(--dg-primary-ink, #FB923C); font-family:var(--dg-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); font-size:.64rem; } .ds-doc-architecture strong { font-size:.9rem; } .ds-doc-architecture small { color:var(--dg-muted, #9AA3B2); font-family:var(--dg-mono, "Geist Mono", monospace); font-size:.68rem; } .ds-doc-architecture li:hover { background:var(--dg-surface-2, #1A1E27); border-color:rgba(249,115,22,.32); }

narrative.overview:
DeployGuard is a calm, dense operational interface built from graphite surfaces, restrained borders, and one orange product signal. The visual system should feel like a dependable control room: exact without becoming sterile, technical without turning into a wall of terminal chrome, and confident without visual noise.

Architecture, deployment state, runtime health, and immutable evidence carry the hierarchy. Marketing language supports those artifacts rather than competing with them. Orange identifies product actions, selection, focus, and the active path; green, yellow, red, and blue appear only when the interface is communicating status.

The system is flat by default. Depth comes from tonal separation, fine hairlines, compact grouping, and a single shared atmospheric glow rather than glass, blur, or decorative gradients. Motion confirms state change; route entry and static surfaces remain immediate.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral graphite environment across public, authenticated, project, and administration routes.
One orange product accent, reserved for actions, focus, active navigation, and control-path emphasis.
Semantic color appears only where success, warning, danger, or in-progress information is being communicated.
Modern sans hierarchy for human-facing content; compact mono type for evidence, labels, identifiers, and numeric data.
Dense but calm layouts that elevate architecture and operational proof above promotional copy.
Accessible contrast, visible focus, restrained motion, and responsive evidence views.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange is the only non-semantic accent and should remain visually scarce enough to identify the action or active path immediately.

rules.name: The Status Means Status Rule
rules.body: Green, yellow, red, and blue are not page themes or decoration; they communicate verified state only.

rules.name: The Shared Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Every route uses the same subtle orange radial glow at the top-left edge of the graphite canvas; do not introduce route-specific color worlds.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Sans explains and directs; mono identifies and proves. Do not set ordinary body copy or major headings in monospace.

rules.name: The Consistent Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Eyebrows use the compact mono label treatment and orange signal ink unless a neutral evidence context explicitly requires muted ink.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: When architecture or runtime evidence and promotional copy share a surface, allocate more space and stronger grouping to the evidence.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a border and tonal shift establish the hierarchy, do not add another shadow.

rules.name: The One Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: The shared radial orange glow belongs to the canvas, never to individual cards or decorative blobs.

dos: Do keep every route on the Graphite Canvas with the shared subtle orange atmosphere.
Do reserve Control Orange for primary actions, focus, active navigation, selection, and control-path emphasis.
Do use semantic colors only when presenting verified status or runtime state.
Do use Geist Mono for evidence, identifiers, labels, timestamps, boundaries, and tabular values.
Do make architecture, lifecycle state, diagnostics, and immutable evidence more prominent than explanatory or promotional copy.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, readable contrast, 44px mobile targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce route-specific accent palettes, decorative multicolor gradients, or colored atmosphere fields.
Don't use green, yellow, red, or blue as generic decoration or branding.
Don't add glass blur, glossy highlights, or elevated shadows to ordinary content surfaces.
Don't turn all technical content into monospace; keep headings and explanations in Geist.
Don't hide operational evidence behind marketing spectacle, oversized copy, or ornamental motion.
Don't use pills for primary buttons, ordinary cards, or top-level navigation.
